name: Zanele Botha
headline: Dynamic, results-driven team player with 18 years of customer service leadership. Proven in synergy-driven contact centre operations. Expertise in performance optimization, team development, and service excellence.
summary: Dynamic, synergy-focused, results-driven team player with 18 years of customer service leadership. Proven in driving team performance, service excellence, and operational efficiency across diverse contact centre environments. Adept at building high-performing, customer-centric teams with measurable outcomes.

bullets: Led a 12-member contact centre team at CallFirst Solutions (Pretoria), improving first-call resolution by 32% using Zendesk and CRM dashboards over 18 months.
Reduced average handling time from 8.4 to 6.1 minutes by implementing a structured script framework and training modules in ServiceFlow, boosting team efficiency by 28%.
Spearheaded a shift to AI-powered chatbots at CallFirst, reducing ticket volume by 40% and cutting response time from 12 to 4 minutes during peak hours.
Conducted weekly performance reviews using KPI dashboards in Salesforce, increasing team retention by 35% and reducing attrition by 22% over 12 months.
roles.title: Contact Centre Team Leader

bullets: Managed a 10-member team at Naledi Support Services, achieving 98% CSAT scores through daily feedback loops and service excellence workshops using ServiceNow.
Introduced a real-time performance tracking system in CallCenterPro, reducing escalations by 38% and improving agent confidence by 40% in 10 months.
Led a cross-functional initiative to integrate WhatsApp support, increasing customer reach by 55% and handling 12,000+ messages monthly.
Trained 25 new agents on compliance and service standards, reducing onboarding time by 45% and improving new hire performance by 30% within 3 months.
roles.title: Senior Customer Service Supervisor

bullets: Directed operations for a 15-agent contact centre at Vuma Connect, increasing daily call volume by 60% through process redesign and agent empowerment.

Reduced customer complaints by 44% through proactive issue identification and agent coaching using Power BI dashboards.
